fullDesc: On February 9, 2020 Bong Joon-ho's Parasite won the Oscar for Best Picture, the first film not in English to do so. It also won Best Director, Best Original Screenplay and Best International Feature.
realFacts: It had earlier won the Palme d'Or at Cannes
Bong urged viewers to read subtitles
It boosted interest in Korean cinema
It was a major box-office hit for a foreign-language film
